subcategory_text: Priorities for organizational mission, objectives, and activities are established and communicated.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-3 (Information Security and Privacy Resources), PM-8 (Critical Infrastructure System Inventory)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.2 (Information security roles and responsibilities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.OC-02 (organisational priorities understood)
implementation_examples: Establish and document the organisation's priorities for mission, objectives, and activities, with explicit privacy dimensions included where data processing supports them
Communicate priorities to the workforce and to relevant third parties so risk-allocation decisions are anchored to mission criticality
Re-prioritise when mission drivers shift (regulator action, market disruption, board strategic review)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether organisational priorities are documented and include privacy dimensions where relevant
Determine whether priorities are communicated to the workforce and to third parties
Determine whether priorities are reviewed at a defined cadence
Determine whether privacy-risk decisions reference the priority hierarchy
